name: Export modal validates Pure-TS ISOBMFF Fast-Start MP4 muxer configuration and Godot/Unity game engine sprite sheet packing
description: Validates opening the Export modal in the studio workspace, switching between isolated export tabs, inspecting the MP4 Video tab with Pure-TypeScript ISOBMFF progressive download Fast-Start container settings, and configuring the Sprite Sheet tab with horizontal, vertical, and grid matrix layouts.

planSteps.description: Click the Export button in the top navigation bar
Verify the Export modal opens displaying the format category tabs
Click the 'MP4 Video' format tab button
Verify the MP4 export tab displays Scale Resolution options and MP4 output info
Click the 'Sprite Sheet' format tab button
Verify the Sprite Sheet panel displays Layout Packing options and Engine Metadata toggle
Verify the grid layout mode button is active
Verify the Export modal is dismissed and studio canvas is visible
